invoicing.policy: Invoicing 2.22.0 preserves the completed billing product and now exposes business-owner payment-provider connections for Pesapal, M-PESA, Stripe, Paystack, Flutterwave and PayPal. Long-term merchant credentials remain encrypted and workspace-scoped; provider-native callbacks are verified, duplicate-safe and routed through the authoritative payment, allocation, invoice-status and Accounting-posting core. The ordinary Invoicing UI does not expose bearer-token or generic webhook configuration. The release gate includes Invoicing regressions, payment-provider connector contracts, parity-hardening, quality locks, module migrations, responsive/app UI, ERP integration, TypeScript and production build.
